resources.name: Roguish Adaptation — Sneak Attack Applies
resources.description: While at least one Roguish Adaptation talent is active, toggle this when the target is flanked or denied Dexterity to AC. Damage is 1d6, +1d6 at Prodigy 7 and 16.

power_providers.label: Roguish Adaptation
power_providers.description: Temporarily choose non-advanced rogue talents. Each newly gained or replaced slot spends one Adaptation use; combat-feat and ninja-trick gateway talents are unavailable. Prodigy level counts as Rogue level. A full rest ends the current selection.

entries.notes: Roguish Adaptation uses the shared class-power catalog, spends the shared Adaptation pool, excludes advanced/combat gateway options, grants its correct sneak-attack progression, and ends on a full rest.
